main_text.head: EPIGRAMMATA IN EVNDEM.
In D. Petri Martyris Vermilij Florentini imaginem, Ioannis Parkhursti Angli Tetrastichon.

p.i: Florida quem genuit Florentia, Martyris ista Effigiem Petri picta tabella refert. Doctrinam, ingenium, dotes animiq; stupendas, Non posset Cicero pingere pro meritis.

main_text.head: RODOLPHVS Gualtherus in nuptias D. PETRI MARTYRIS Vermilij & Catharinæ Merendæ.

p.i: Quòd Christum vita semper testaris & ore, Martyris haud frustra nobile nomen habes. At Catharina simul sociali fœdere iuncta, Indicat à Christo præmia parta tibi. Ille suos proprio mundatos sanguine testes Et sponsæ & proprij corporis instar habet. Accipite hæc igitur saluantis symbola Christi, Et læti optato viuite coniugio. Hic precor optata faciat vos prole parentes, Quæ matrem referat, patris & ingenium.

main_text.head: Regula Zuinglia Gualtheri uxor cum pro Eliperio Vermilio D. Petri Martyris F. fidem suam in baptismo obstringeret.

p.i: Parue puer, docti spes exoptata parentis, Exiguum magni pignus amoris habe[?].

page.notes: The faint mirrored text at the top right and along the right edge is show-through from the other side and is left out. The last word of the final verse line, "habe", is followed by a printer's ornament, so the final letter is doubtful and marked [?]. The printer's lozenge ornaments at line ends (for example after "ima", "nu", "Pe") are not hyphens; those words are written whole. The date line is set right-aligned; "1 5 5 9" is printed with wide spacing and is given as 1559. No running head or page number is clearly printed on this page.
